name: propose_storyboard

input.title: Crumb & Co: hand-drawn bakery sting
input.styleReason: Warm, imperfect, human feel for a bakery; wobbly line art and earthy blobs fit the craft brand.

concepts.name: Rising crumb
concepts.idea: The wheat stalk draws up from the bottom edge like a sprout, the loaf outline draws around it, and the blobs swell like dough under the lines.
concepts.why: Bread rises and grows; the stalk and loaf are the depicted objects acting, not parts assembling.

concepts.name: Hand-sketched menu card
concepts.idea: Stalk and loaf are drawn as a pencil sketch with boil, then the name is underlined with a scribbled stroke.
concepts.why: Reads like a baker's hand-drawn chalkboard, friendly and honest.

beats.name: Stalk draws up
beats.description: Wobbly wheat stalk line draws up from the bottom centre-left (trimEnd 0→100), grain heads sprout with small arcs. Two warm blobs (mustard, terracotta) fade up under it.
beats.style: Sine In Out draw-ons 1.2 s, boil wiggle on strokes, blobs ease Quad Out.

beats.name: Loaf draws on
beats.description: A hand-drawn loaf outline draws on to the right of the stalk, with a scoring line across it. Sage blob grows behind it.
beats.style: Sine In Out, staggered 0.4 s after stalk.

beats.name: Name appears
beats.description: 'Crumb & Co' appears in friendly serif, letters rise in with a soft stagger; a terracotta scribble underline draws under it.
beats.style: Quad Out per letter, 0.03 s stagger; underline Sine In Out.

beats.name: Breathe and hold
beats.description: Blobs breathe slowly (scale ±2%), line boil continues, everything settles into the final lockup.
